description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Validates the priced order, reserves inventory, walks a ladder of increasingly desperate payment processors (the last rung always approves), dispatches the order and confirms it. Uses system tasks only, so no worker has to be running, and falls back to chaos_checkout_rescue on any failure: checkout always completes.
name: chaos_checkout

["behind the vending machine", "aisle Q (we have three aisles)", "Gary's car", "the 'misc' pile", "a different warehouse, spiritually", "under the other inventory"] as $spots | .seed as $seed | {allReserved: true, reservations: [.lines | to_entries[] | {sku: .value.sku, qty: .value.qty, status: "RESERVED", foundAt: $spots[($seed + .key) % ($spots | length)]}]}

description: Safety net for chaos_checkout. Conductor starts it automatically (failureWorkflow) when a checkout fails or times out, and the backend starts it when a checkout was terminated by hand. It confirms the order from the original input in a single step, so a broken checkout still ends in a completed order.
name: chaos_checkout_rescue

inputParameters.queryExpression: def text($d): if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:300] else $d end; def cents: if type == "number" and . > 0 then floor else 0 end; (.quote | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $q | ([($q.lines | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end) | select(type == "object")][0:50]) as $lines | ($q.totalCents | cents) as $total | (.paymentMethod | text("Mystery Method")) as $method | {orderId: (.orderId | text("CC-UNNUMBERED")), status: "CONFIRMED", rescued: true, rescueReason: (.reason | text("The checkout machinery fell over.")), failedWorkflowId: (.failedWorkflowId | text("unknown")), customerName: (.customer | if type == "object" then .name else null end | text("Valued Customer #NaN")), paymentMethod: $method, shippingSpeed: (.shippingSpeed | text("Slow")), placedAt: (.placedAt | text("a Tuesday")), lines: (if ($lines | length) == 0 then [{sku: "nothing", name: "Box of Nothing", emoji: "🕳️", qty: 1, unitPriceCents: 0, returnable: false, lineTotalCents: 0}] else $lines end), fees: ([($q.fees | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end) | select(type == "object")][0:20]), subtotalCents: ($q.subtotalCents | cents), feesCents: ($q.feesCents | cents), totalCents: $total, payment: {method: $method, attempts: [], declines: 0, amountCents: $total, settled: {attempt: 1, processor: "Gary from Accounting (manual override)", approved: true, message: "The checkout machinery fell over, so Gary pushed your order through by hand."}}, inventory: {allReserved: true, reservations: []}, shipping: {courier: "Gary (he feels responsible)", eta: "eventually", speedRequested: (.shippingSpeed | text("Slow")), speedHonoured: false, tracking: "CHAOS-RESCUED"}, loyalty: {points: 0, tier: "Cardboard", note: "No points were harmed in the rescue of this order."}, message: "Order confirmed the hard way. Our checkout broke; your order did not."}

description: Chaos Commerce returns. Drags the return through six pointless departmental checks (each waits in a queue, none can affect the outcome, the loop is capped), then hands the case to chaos_return_verdict for the actual decision. Uses system tasks only, so no worker has to be running, and falls back to chaos_return_rescue on any failure: every return reaches a decision.
name: chaos_return

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ var step = Number($.step) || 1; var id = String($.returnId || ''); var seed = 0; for (var k = 0; k < id.length; k++) { seed = (seed * 31 + id.charCodeAt(k)) % 100003; } var regret = ($.answers && $.answers.regret != null) ? String($.answers.regret).slice(0, 4) : 'unstated'; var checks = [['Department of Redundancy Department', 'Confirmed that this return is a return. Then confirmed it again.'], ['Bureau of Receipt Vibes', 'Inspected the aura of your receipt. It is beige.'], ['Lunar Compliance Office', 'Checked the phase of the moon. There is a moon.'], ['Office of the Intern (Gary)', 'Gary looked at your file. Gary shrugged.'], ['Regret Notarisation Desk', 'Regret level ' + regret + ' out of 10 notarised, then filed under irrelevant.'], ['Final Pointless Review Board', 'Reviewed all previous checks and certified them pointless.']]; var verdicts = ['PASSED', 'FAILED', 'INCONCLUSIVE', 'FORM LOST', 'PASSED BY ACCIDENT']; var c = checks[(step - 1) % checks.length]; return { step: step, of: checks.length, department: c[0], finding: c[1], verdict: verdicts[(seed + step * 7) % verdicts.length], affectsDecision: false }; })();

description: Safety net for chaos_return. Conductor starts it automatically (failureWorkflow) when a return fails or times out, and the backend starts it when a return was terminated by hand. It skips the pointless checks and goes straight to chaos_return_verdict; if even that fails, the return is denied by default, so the case is never left undecided.
name: chaos_return_rescue

inputParameters.queryExpression: def text($d): if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:120] else $d end; if (.verdict | type) == "object" and (.verdict.decision | type) == "string" then .verdict else {decision: "DENIED", approved: false, code: "PAPERWORK_FIRE", amountCents: 0, reference: "DN-FIRE", headline: "Return denied by default", detail: "The returns process and its backup both caught fire, so nothing about this return could be verified and no money can move.", returnId: (.returnId | text("RT-UNNUMBERED")), orderId: (.orderId | text("")), sku: (.sku | text("")), itemName: "an item we cannot identify", qty: 0, reason: "other"} end

description: The only part of a Chaos Commerce return that matters. Establishes the facts of the return, applies the returns policy and issues exactly one outcome: REFUND, STORE_CREDIT or DENIED. Shared by chaos_return (after the pointless checks) and chaos_return_rescue (instead of them), so the policy lives in one place.
name: chaos_return_verdict

inputParameters.queryExpression: def text($d): if type == "string" and length > 0 then .[0:120] else $d end; (.order | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $o | (.sku | text("")) as $sku | ([($o.lines | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end) | select(type == "object") | select(.sku == $sku)] | .[0]) as $line | ($line.qty | if type == "number" and . >= 1 then floor else 0 end) as $bought | (.qty | if type == "number" and . >= 1 then floor else 1 end) as $wanted | (.reasonCode | text("other")) as $reason | {returnId: (.returnId | text("RT-UNNUMBERED")), orderId: (.orderId | text("")), sku: $sku, itemName: ($line.name | text("an item we cannot identify")), reason: (if (["defective", "not_as_described", "arrived_on_fire", "changed_mind", "too_expensive", "haunted", "other"] | any(. == $reason)) then $reason else "other" end), orderFound: ($o.found == true), orderComplete: ($o.status == "COMPLETED"), itemInOrder: ($line != null), returnable: ($line != null and $line.returnable != false), qty: ([$wanted, $bought] | min), unitPriceCents: ($line.unitPriceCents | if type == "number" and . > 0 then floor else 0 end)}

.facts as $f | ($f.qty * $f.unitPriceCents) as $value | if ($f.orderFound | not) then {decision: "DENIED", code: "ORDER_NOT_FOUND", amountCents: 0} elif ($f.orderComplete | not) then {decision: "DENIED", code: "ORDER_NOT_COMPLETE", amountCents: 0} elif ($f.itemInOrder | not) then {decision: "DENIED", code: "ITEM_NOT_IN_ORDER", amountCents: 0} elif ($f.returnable | not) then {decision: "DENIED", code: "FINAL_SALE", amountCents: 0} elif (["defective", "not_as_described", "arrived_on_fire"] | any(. == $f.reason)) then {decision: "REFUND", code: "FAULTY_ITEM", amountCents: $value} else {decision: "STORE_CREDIT", code: "CHANGE_OF_HEART", amountCents: $value} end

{decision: "REFUND", approved: true, code: .policy.code, amountCents: .policy.amountCents, reference: ("RF-" + (.facts.returnId | ltrimstr("RT-"))), headline: "Refund approved", detail: "Item price refunded in full for \(.facts.qty) x \(.facts.itemName). Fees are not refunded, because fees are forever."}

{decision: "STORE_CREDIT", approved: true, code: .policy.code, amountCents: .policy.amountCents, reference: ("SC-" + (.facts.returnId | ltrimstr("RT-"))), headline: "Approved for store credit", detail: "Store credit issued for \(.facts.qty) x \(.facts.itemName). It can only be spent at Chaos Commerce, which we appreciate is the problem."}

{ORDER_NOT_FOUND: "We have no record of that order. Given our record-keeping that proves little, but rules are rules.", ORDER_NOT_COMPLETE: "That order has not finished being sold to you yet. Nothing can be returned. (.refund // .credit // .denial) + {returnId: .facts.returnId, orderId: .facts.orderId, sku: .facts.sku, itemName: .facts.itemName, qty: .facts.qty, reason: .facts.reason}
